name: MonarchRolePicker
title: RolePicker
wrapsNative: MonarchRadioCardGroup (androidx.compose.material3.Surface selectable cards with RadioButton) for cards; androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with a read-only OutlinedTextField for compact
summary: Chooses a role for a person, with what each role can do in plain words, as radio cards or a compact menu field. Roles that cannot be chosen stay visible with the reason.
whenToUse: In invite, member and sharing forms, where the person must understand what a role allows before choosing it.
whenNotToUse: For choices without descriptions use a MonarchRadioRow list or a Material 3 ExposedDropdownMenuBox. For several permissions at once use a list of MonarchSwitchRow or MonarchCheckboxRow.
api: @Composable fun <T> MonarchRolePicker(roles: List<MonarchRoleOption<T>>, selected: T?, onSelect: (T) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, layout: MonarchRolePickerLayout = MonarchRolePickerLayout.Cards, enabled: Boolean = true, label: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null)
class MonarchRoleOption<out T>(value: T, title: String, description: String? = null, capabilities: List<String> = emptyList(), enabled: Boolean = true, disabledReason: String? = null)

options.name: roles
options.description: The roles, from least to most access.

options.name: selected
options.description: The value of the chosen role, or null for no choice yet.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the value of the role the person chooses.

options.name: layout
options.description: Cards shows every role with its description and capabilities; Compact is a menu field with the chosen role's description under it.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether any role can be chosen.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error under the control in the danger strong color; replaces the helper text. The compact field also takes the error semantics.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Replaces the compact field's built-in "Choose a role", shown while nothing is chosen.

states.name: selected
states.description: Cards: the radio card's filled mark, accent fill and heavier border. Compact: the role's name in the field and its description under it.

states.name: role disabled
states.description: The card in the disabled colors with the reason under the description; in the menu the item cannot be chosen and shows the reason.

states.name: error
states.description: The error text in the danger strong color under the control.

states.name: disabled
states.description: enabled = false disables every role and the compact field.

appearance: The cards layout is MonarchRadioCardGroup and takes its colors. The compact layout is the Material 3 exposed dropdown with the MonarchTextField colors. Helper text uses the muted text role; errors the danger strong role. All roles come from the theme.
platformNotes: The web's compact layout is a custom select with descriptions in each option; Android uses the Material 3 ExposedDropdownMenuBox, whose items show the description and capabilities under the title, with the chosen role's description under the field, as iOS shows it under its menu picker. Capabilities are lines of the card text, because MonarchRadioCardOption takes one description. Selection is hoisted as selected and onSelect, as in MonarchRadioCardGroup, instead of the iOS Binding. The web's required marker and form name have no Android equivalent. The error has no icon because Monarch bundles none; it is text with the error semantics on the compact field.
accessibility: Cards: each role is a radio button with its title and its description, capabilities and reason, selected when chosen, in a selectable group with the label.
Compact: a Material 3 read-only field named by the label that opens a menu; disabled roles cannot be chosen.
The compact field sets the error semantics with the error text; the error is text, not color alone.
Every card and the field are at least 48dp high.
edgeCases: A selection that matches no role shows no card selected and the compact placeholder.
Long descriptions and many capabilities wrap inside the card and the menu item.
A disabled role without a reason shows only its description.

examples.title: Radio cards
examples.template:
MonarchRolePicker(
    roles = listOf(
        MonarchRoleOption({{roles.0.value}}, title = {{roles.0.label}}, description = {{roles.0.description}}),
        MonarchRoleOption({{roles.1.value}}, title = {{roles.1.label}}, description = {{roles.1.description}}, capabilities = listOf({{roles.1.capabilities.0}}, {{roles.1.capabilities.1}})),
        MonarchRoleOption({{roles.2.value}}, title = {{roles.2.label}}, description = {{roles.2.description}}),
        MonarchRoleOption(
            {{roles.3.value}},
            title = {{roles.3.label}},
            description = {{roles.3.description}},
            enabled = !{{roles.3.disabled}},
            disabledReason = {{roles.3.disabledReason}},
        ),
    ),
    selected = role,
    onSelect = { role = it },
    label = {{label}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchRolePicker(
    roles = listOf(
        MonarchRoleOption("viewer", title = "Viewer", description = "Can see everything in the workspace but cannot change it."),
        MonarchRoleOption("member", title = "Member", description = "Can create and edit work in the apps they have access to.", capabilities = listOf("Create and edit records", "Comment and mention people")),
        MonarchRoleOption("admin", title = "Admin", description = "Can also invite and remove members and change workspace settings."),
        MonarchRoleOption(
            "owner",
            title = "Owner",
            description = "Full control, including billing and deleting the workspace.",
            enabled = !true,
            disabledReason = "Only an owner can make someone an owner.",
        ),
    ),
    selected = role,
    onSelect = { role = it },
    label = "Role",
)

examples.title: Compact, with an error
examples.code:
MonarchRolePicker(
    roles = listOf(
        MonarchRoleOption("viewer", title = "Viewer", description = "Can see everything, change nothing."),
        MonarchRoleOption("editor", title = "Editor", description = "Can edit content."),
    ),
    selected = role,
    onSelect = { role = it },
    layout = MonarchRolePickerLayout.Compact,
    errorText = if (role == null) "Choose a role to send the invitation." else null,
)
